---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for Litefin
title: '[FEAT] Feature title'
labels: enhancement
assignees: MoazSalem
---

**Target Platform(s)**
Check all platforms that apply:

- [ ] All Platforms (Universal)
- [ ] Android TV / Fire TV
- [ ] Android Mobile / Tablet
- [ ] Samsung Smart TV (Tizen)
- [ ] LG Smart TV (webOS)
- [ ] Desktop (Windows, Linux, macOS)
- [ ] Web Plugin (Jellyfin / Emby Web)

**Build Type**:
Include the build you need for testing the feature. [e.g. webOS Modern - Tizen legacy]

**Priority** (1-10):
From a scale of 1 to 10 (1 = minor annoyance, 10 = critical crash/unusable blocker), how important is this feature?

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

**Device / Input Context (if applicable)**
Does this feature involve specific input methods or hardware capabilities? (e.g., TV Remote / D-Pad, Touch gestures, Mouse & Keyboard shortcuts, Multichannel audio passthrough, Window management).

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.
